objective: Validate the locally generated Security Onion Hunt OQL equivalent and its compilation to the fixed Query DSL execution path without claiming that the SOC Hunt API executed the OQL text.
preconditions: a trusted typed OQL-dialect broker request and authorization envelope exist
the deployed Security Onion 2.4 pack and field catalog are available
the OQL renderer and compiled Query DSL validator versions agree
required_evidence: OQL equivalent text and digest bound to the request item
canonical compiled Query DSL index scope endpoint and execution digest
successful controls result coverage truncation and evidence references
positive_evidence: the generated OQL contains only reviewed Lucene predicates and the allowlisted timeline sort segment
independent compilation produces the same bounded Query DSL and admitted result projection
negative_evidence: the successful complete compiled Query DSL result refutes the scoped hypothesis over exact authorized filters
independent validation proves the OQL and compiled execution semantics diverge so the OQL cannot support the claim
escalation_pivots: rebuild OQL and Query DSL independently from the same typed request
inspect Security Onion pack fields datasets and OQL renderer version
stop for operator review when OQL compilation execution or provenance digests disagree

query_templates.purpose: Validate the generated Security Onion Hunt OQL and its compiled equivalent while never claiming the OQL text was executed through the SOC Hunt API.

alternative_hypotheses: the OQL display is valid but compiled execution is partial
Security Onion OQL or field mappings changed in the deployed release
a display or digest mismatch is provenance failure rather than contrary evidence
the typed request exceeds its trusted scope or reviewed grammar
stop_conditions: OQL and compiled Query DSL independently validate from the same typed request
a mapping control compilation or provenance failure is reported without claiming OQL execution
the next bounded reviewed query has low expected information value
a query budget or deadline is exhausted
confidence_limiters: OQL is compiled to Query DSL rather than executed through the SOC Hunt API
Security Onion release-specific grammar or field drift
missing OQL Query DSL or request digest linkage
known_false_positive_patterns: valid OQL display mistaken for a separate execution record
routine Security Onion hunt filters over benign traffic
shared infrastructure represented by exact fields
timeline sort presentation mistaken for evidence ordering completeness
